version: v1.5.0 — FPS Boost + Turbo F2/F10 + Browsing (Game 1.0.9)
name: Geoplanetical Fire Performance Mod
description:
Made this mod for my laptop (8GB RAM / integrated graphics) to get smooth 60 FPS and make Speed 3 actually fast, but works on all PCs!

WHAT IT DOES:
- Massive FPS Boost (removes heavy 8K textures, 3D clouds/atmosphere lag, and UI compositor blurs)
- Turbo Speed 3 (>>> runs way faster at ~16 days/sec with smooth daily date counter)
- Month-End UI Browsing (freely open budget/trade/diplomacy tabs while the turn calculates without UI freezing)
- Hotkeys: Press F10 for Fire Graphics, press F2 for Turbo Speed 3 (F11 fullscreen is untouched!)

EASY 1-CLICK INSTALL:
Because Steam Workshop only loads flags/images by default, you need to run the installer once:
1. In Geoplanetical main menu, click "Mods".
2. Click "Mod studio" on this mod, then click "Open folder".
3. Double-click Install-Mod.bat and wait until it says Done.
4. Launch the game! You will see 'FIRE [F10] · TURBO [F2]' and FPS in the top-right corner.

HOW TO TOGGLE OR UNINSTALL:
- Press F10 anytime to toggle Fire Graphics ON/OFF with an on-screen toast.
- Press F2 anytime to toggle Turbo Speed 3 ON/OFF.
- Or turn the mod off in the Mods menu, or run Uninstall-Mod.bat.

UPDATE v1.5.0:
- Split hotkeys: F10 for Graphics, F2 for Turbo Speed (no conflict with F11 fullscreen!)
- Added 2-second on-screen toast notifications when pressing F10 or F2
- Added Month-End UI Browsing during heavy simulation ticks
- Simplified 1-click install via Mod Studio 'Open folder' button
